description: Look up one indexed China/Hong Kong/Taiwan news article by its URL and return everything known about it: publisher, headline, publication time, GDELT theme tags, average article tone and the places it mentions. Pass a url exactly as china_news_search returned it. There is no article text — GDELT indexes metadata only — and this tool says so explicitly rather than returning an empty body field.

url.description: The article URL, as returned by china_news_search.

name: china_news_article
title: China News Article
